title: Comparison of lifted affine tensor-section Cech complexes with Amitsur complexes
statement: Let X be a scheme, F a quasi-coherent X-module, U an etale X-scheme, and (V_i to U) a finite affine etale Cech cover [new-etale-finite-affine-cech-basis]. Put A = Gamma(U, O_U) and M = Gamma(U, U.hom*F), using the tensor pullback [lem-pc-module-pullback-identity-composition]. There exist a commutative ring B and a ring homomorphism a from A to B for which B is a faithfully flat A-module, and an isomorphism between the Mathlib Cech complex of the restricted lifted tensor-section sheaf [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module] and the Amitsur complex of B over A with coefficients in M [lem-pc-cech-exact], after forgetting scalars and applying ULift. The isomorphism is an isomorphism of complexes in every nonnegative degree; no exactness or vanishing is asserted.

source.place: Tags 03OZ and 03P2, affine-case proof: identification with (B/A) tensor M before applying exactness; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03P2 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03OZ

proof.text: Pull F back to the affine U. Quasi-coherence transports from abstract pullback to tensorPullback through the unique isomorphism of left adjoints to pushforward. The unit-normalized composition isomorphisms identify the restricted tensor-section presheaf with the tensor sections of this pullback on U. Set A = Gamma(U, O_U) and M = Gamma(U, U.hom*F).

Reindex the finite type I by Fin n and view its members as etale U-schemes. The standard-cover theorem replaces the finite affine family by the affine disjoint union W and identifies their Cech complexes. Set B = Gamma(W, O_W) and a the homomorphism on global sections. Since W to U is flat and surjective, B is faithfully flat over A. Transfer across the affine chart U isomorphic to Spec A.

Affine fibre products identify the rings of iterated products of W over U with tensor powers of B. Apply the affine pullback-sections formula with the quasi-coherent pullback of F to identify the degree n group with M tensor B tensor ... tensor B, with n+1 copies of B. The pure-tensor formula for section pullback and coherence of the normalized composition isomorphisms show that the face maps insert 1 into the indicated tensor position. Thus these identifications form an isomorphism with the underlying abelian-group Amitsur complex, not just isomorphisms of its terms.

The equivalence from the small etale site of U to the over category over U preserves products. Apply the existing nonempty_etale_siteCech_complex_iso (lem-weil-pbc-etale-site-cech-complex-comparison) to compare SiteCechComplex with Mathlib cechComplexFunctor, including compatibility with every face map. Compose with the standard-cover comparison. Apply ULift to all groups and maps and use its preservation of finite products to obtain the displayed isomorphism of lifted complexes. If I is empty, the covering condition forces U empty; the section ring and module are zero, and both complexes are zero.

theorem exists_etaleTensorSectionsSheaf_ulift_cech_amitsur_iso
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : X.Etale) (I : Type (u + 1)) (V : I → X.Etale) (f : ∀ i : I, V i ⟶ U)
    (hf : finiteAffineEtaleCechCover X U I V f) :
    ∃ (B : CommRingCat.{u}) (a : Γ(U.left, ⊤) →+* B),
      letI : Algebra Γ(U.left, ⊤) B := a.toAlgebra
      Module.FaithfullyFlat Γ(U.left, ⊤) B ∧
        Nonempty (((cechComplexFunctor fun i : I ↦ Over.mk (f i)).obj
          ((Over.forget U).op ⋙
            ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
              (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf F)).obj)) ≅
          (((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(U.left, ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ⋙
            AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.amitsurComplex Γ(U.left, ⊤) B
                Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj F, ⊤)))
